name: fact-check
description: Checks a spec or plan for claims that would break the implementer agent, and for external facts that no longer trace to a cited page, returning one {verdict, target, findings} object. Mandatory after generate-spec and after plan, before either is shown for approval: ultracode_gate refuses approval without a recorded PASS. Its spawn sets how far it goes: `Prior findings:` scopes a re-pass to the previous findings plus changed text, and `Source check:` decides whether it re-opens cited pages. Read-only on project source.
